title: Logan Paul releases new limited-edition PRIME bottle honoring Oliver Tree's legacy
summary_full: Logan Paul has launched a limited-edition version of PRIME inspired by Oliver Tree, with every dollar earned going to the late musician's foundation. The initiative honors the late singer and supports grants for young artists. It also carries forward Tree's vision of helping creators bring their ideas to life through hands-on artistic projects.
